about: PROPOSAL from the story director (stage 4) for level-design owned fields: levels.js story (+ text[].story), optional startLine, and chapters.json intro/tagline. Level design merges; this file is not read at runtime. Checked by design/story/tools/check-story.mjs (errors). 'intro' marks a stage that introduces a mechanic: its story line is the hint said in world words (narrative-structure 4.0-3). startLine is only set where the story director suggests 'hint' (button names matter); empty = default 'story'.

stages.en: Count from one. The seventh step opens.
The door is near. The stars aren't.

stages.story: 길은 많아도, 일곱 걸음 길은 하나.
stages.en: Many roads. Only one is seven steps.
Stay on the seventh step, as stone.
The plate waits for someone to stand.
The stone that holds also blocks.
Past the last door, the road begins.

stages.story: 그 자리에서 지도를 건넬 수도 있다.
stages.en: Or hand the map over, right there.
Too far for one. Not for three.
Only a seventh step bridges a hole.
To be a bridge, or a stone?
Across the hole, the next one wakes.
The stars below grow deeper.
Past the holes, the next star shines.

stages.story: 문에 새긴 수는 지나갈 걸음의 차례.
stages.en: The carved number says which step passes.
Beyond the carving, a place to hold.
Even the short way is carved.

stages.story: 먼 문 앞에서, 처음부터 다시 센다.
stages.en: A far door. Count again from one.
Steps over a bridge count too.
Where it's handed sets the next count.
The old stones are just their height.
On ice, one slide is one step.
The floor alone won't make seven.
The carvings count slides too.

stages.story: 벽이 없으면, 서 있는 돌이 멈춘다.
stages.en: No wall? A standing stone stops you.

stages.story: 멈춰 준 돌이, 다음 길을 막는다.
stages.en: The stone that stops may also block.
If the slide ends at a hole…
Past the ice, the home star shows.
On the seventh, the handle flips walls.
One opens, and another closes.
A risen wall can stop a slide.
A handle turns once. A plate holds.
Move the walls, and the count shifts.
The brass handles sit at their height.

stages.story: 마지막 톱니가 금 간 별을 가리킨다.
stages.en: The last gear points at cracked ground.

stages.story: 지난 곳은 무너지고 선 곳은 굳는다.
stages.en: Passed floors fall, but a stop holds.
Choose which road falls and which stays.

stages.story: 문은 서 있는 선돌의 수를 센다.
stages.en: The gate counts the stones still standing.
Nowhere roads have their use too.
This gate opens while no stone stands.

stages.story: 굳은 바닥은 길일 뿐, 돌이 아니다.
stages.en: Sealed floor is road, not stone.
No way back. Only counting forward.

stages.story: 늪의 진흙은 한 칸에 두 걸음.
stages.en: Bog mud takes two steps a square.
Mud skips a number in the count.
Ice runs fast. Mud weighs heavy.

stages.story: 배운 셈을, 이 방에서 다 쓴다.
stages.en: Every count they learned, in one room.

stages.story: 닫힌 문 하나가 길의 전부는 아니다.
stages.en: A shut gate isn't the only way.
Over the traces, the last steps pass.

stages.story: 일곱 칸 일곱 줄, 원이 가까워진다.
stages.en: Seven by seven. The circle draws near.

stages.story: 이번 바퀴의 한 밤, 원 한가운데로.
stages.en: One night this turn. Into the circle.

en.intro: Without stars, no step will count.
Find the count that crosses holes.
en.tagline: A moon of holes and stars

en.intro: The circle's count is carved here.
Close the bowl before going onward.
Only the old gears open the rest.
The last foothold before the circle.

chapters.intro: 한 밤 안에 원을 맞춰야 한다.

en.intro: The circle must align this one night.
